inputClasses: RightsDeclaration with VRMMeta, evidence blobs and optional CAWG TrainingClaims

parameterRanges.evidence: Blob list whose sha256 must match the file

invariants: resolve stores the declaration with field-by-field attribution, invalidates meta and appends a revision; a replay under the same requestId is byte-identical
authors that mismatch the meta authors are gateFailed/RIGHTS_CONFLICT at /authors with no receipt and no ledger
evidence with a wrong sha256 or a missing path yields EVIDENCE_HASH_MISMATCH / EVIDENCE_MISSING with revision 0
wrong license URLs and unknown thumbnail/image references are conflicts; the CAWG assertion has the exact pinned shape and omission stays absent
a dry run leaves the ledger untouched
a missing handler is the runner's missing-handler outcome (exit 3) when no test case of the entry-point suite runs; it is never a pass

fixtures.path: synthetic:declaration with matching authors, hashed evidence file and CAWG training claims
fixtures.note: testResolveStoresDeclarationWithAttributionAndNewRevision: attribution table, invalidations [meta], revision 0 to 1, byte-identical replay

fixtures.path: synthetic:authors mismatch; evidence with wrong sha256 and a missing path
fixtures.note: testConflictingRightsAuthorsMismatchFailsWithoutMutation and testEvidenceHashMismatchAndMissingEvidenceAreConflicts: gateFailed with revision 0, no ledger

mutants.description: testConflictingRightsAuthorsMismatchFailsWithoutMutation: authors that differ from meta.authors must be RIGHTS_CONFLICT with no receipt and no ledger.
testEvidenceHashMismatchAndMissingEvidenceAreConflicts: wrong evidence sha256 and a missing evidence file must be ordered conflicts with revision 0.
testResolverRejectsWrongLicenseUnknownThumbnailAndUnknownImageReference: a wrong licenseUrl and unknown image ids must be conflicts until repaired.
testIncompatibleIngredientTermsAndContradictoryDuplicatesConflict: stricter ingredient terms and contradictory duplicates must conflict; a same-id update is allowed.
testCAWGAssertionHasExactShapeAndOmissionStaysAbsent: the CAWG assertion must serialise to the exact canonical string, omission must stay absent and an invalid use value must throw.

A report envelope claiming every ProvenancePackTests test passed (executed 23, failed 0, exit 0) whose oracleHashes name a Tests/VRMAuthorKitTests/Provenance/ProvenancePackTests.swift other than the pinned one. The runner's report-acceptance path must refuse it before any assertion runs.

visual.applicabilityRecord: provenance resolve is a rights-ledger transaction and never renders a frame, so no view, motion or landmark can change its result. Recorded by the acceptance author (claude-fable-5-1); the independent reviewer confirms or overturns this in reviewReceipt.

evidencePolicy.heldOutPolicy: Every fixture is synthetic and built in-process by the suite (or a git-tracked file pinned by sha256); no development-corpus asset is consumed, so no held-out family applies.

canonicalArtifacts: resultHash: sha256 of the canonical result manifest
